output.text: The community hall buzzed with excitement as teams filed in for the monthly pub quiz night. Assume that Kira is the lead volunteer. She arrived early, well before Eli and Nell, who came in together laughing about the traffic. Noor showed up shortly after, carrying a stack of scorecards and pencils for the tables near the back. Yara was already seated at a corner table, chatting with a group of regulars who came every week without fail. Yara is in the same class as Eli. The quizmaster tapped the microphone twice and announced the first round would begin in five minutes, prompting a scramble for drinks at the bar. Kira is noticeably taller than Noor, though both stood near the entrance greeting latecomers with cheerful nods. Eli is not in the same class as Nell. Teams huddled over their answer sheets, whispering guesses about geography and old films while the room grew louder with anticipation. Nell, who is a few years older than Kira, seemed confident about the sports questions and scribbled answers quickly. Yara is not in the same class as Nell. Between rounds, someone shuffled a deck of cards for the raffle draw, and the tension in the room noticeably rose. Noor won the raffle. The final scores were tallied slowly, with volunteers double checking numbers against the master sheet under dim lighting. Eli ranked higher than Nell in the individual bonus round, according to the printed leaderboard pinned near the stage. As the evening wound down, chairs scraped against the floor and empty glasses clinked together while everyone gathered their coats and said their goodbyes, already looking forward to the next quiz night the following month.
